summary: Completed testing of Cronograma/Programa de Obra feature. All backend tests pass (9/9). All frontend tests pass. Feature allows uploading and updating Excel cronograma files for existing projects.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/proyectos/{id}/cronograma correctly returns cronograma info with tiene_cronograma, archivo, fecha_carga, resumen, and frentes
POST /api/proyectos/{id}/actualizar-cronograma correctly accepts Excel files and updates project with parsed cronograma data
GET /api/plantilla-cronograma correctly downloads the Excel template (5483 bytes)
CalendarClock button (data-testid='cronograma-proyecto-{id}') correctly appears on each project card
CronogramaProyectoModal correctly shows 'sin cronograma' state with upload area when no file loaded
CronogramaProyectoModal correctly shows 'Cronograma Cargado' state with resumen and frentes when file exists
'Actualizar' button correctly shows upload form to update existing cronograma
'Descargar plantilla de ejemplo' link correctly visible in both states

POST /api/proyectos/{id}/actualizar-cron.details: Accepts Excel files, parses cronograma, updates project with resumen and frentes

GET /api/plantilla-cronograma.details: Downloads Excel template (5483 bytes, valid xlsx format)
